title: RAW UNREVIEWED: collection time belongs to harvest, not every later helioscopium use
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. In the complete Pliny Natural History XXII.29 chapter as transmitted here specifically in the Bostock/Riley 1856 English translation (not a fresh Latin or medieval collation), the juice is said to be collected in summer at the sixth hour; later sentences separately describe wine mixed in to improve keeping and several application branches. Propose a typed event-scope construction: the time phrase modifies collection of the locally referenced juice, while storage and administration are later events and inherit no noon-use requirement. Read all three source paragraphs and all edition notes 2596–2612, preserving the species and referent uncertainties. This touches IDEA632's seasonal part succession and GDT812's stored-efficacy duration as neighboring concerns, but proposes temporal argument attachment to a collection event. The future Voynich whole unit is not selected or accessed; its exact owner/capacity is unknown. Rival: collection time is a heading for the whole following remedy list or a general dose-time rule. The smallest consequence would change a candidate whole reading from “administer at noon” to “harvest at noon.” No target word is assigned.

design.mechanism: A harvest predicate owns season/hour arguments for a specific juice-collection event; a separate wine-preservation operation and later application events do not inherit those time arguments unless the text explicitly binds them.
design.unit: The entire AF_COMPLETE_PASSAGE.md / AF_COMPLETE_SOURCE.json chapter XXII.29: all three source paragraphs plus edition notes 2596–2612. Source layer: Bostock/Riley, Natural History volume IV, London 1856, English translation; no fresh Latin or medieval manuscript collation.
design.contrast: Event-local harvest time followed by separately scoped storage/use versus a broad time frame inherited by all remedies or interpreted as administration time.
design.prediction: A complete future target account would have to bind collection, material, season/hour, preservation, and each later use as distinct participant/event roles; if those roles cannot be kept separate without shifting referents, the proposed scope fails.
design.scope: Raw source-model proposal only. No target unit or lexical value has been selected; note 2599's taxonomy and the paragraph's plant referents remain uncertain. Neighboring IDs IDEA632 and GDT812 are dependencies, not evidence of a new result.

source_evidence.quote: The juice of this plant is collected in summer, at the sixth [note 2603] hour of the day; it is usually mixed with wine, which makes [note 2604] it keep all the better.
